Definition: from G575 and G5111; to venture plainly:--be very bold.
BiblicalUsage: Paul quotes Isaiah being very bold, saying God was found by those who did not seek Him and made known to those who did not ask for Him. The word is boldness that speaks plainly, without hedging.
TheologicalSignificance: God's grace is bold enough to find people who were not even looking.
